synthetic_findings.finding: The A4 metadata-free S4BlackBoxOracle capability could not reach the existing charged residual/target evaluators because those evaluators dispatched only on EndpointOracle. Every synthetic mechanism therefore failed before its first callback.
synthetic_findings.correction: Add S4BlackBoxOracle-specific residual and target evaluator methods with the same pre-callback ledger charge, shape/finite validation and post-callback deadline path. The numerical mechanism still receives no id, family, group, stratum, mode, generated nullity, Gold or analytic field.

synthetic_findings.finding: A2's physical reference and order-start probes were implemented as fresh smallest-gap route selections. For the frozen quadratic fixture, a confirmation perturbation of radius 1e-6 can have a temporary discarded-to-retained ratio above the 1e-6 endpoint route threshold, contradicting A1's rule that the eligible primary endpoint fixes k for the complete primary and confirmation run.
synthetic_findings.correction: The initial primary endpoint remains the sole gap-based selector of k. Each primary or confirmation reference and order-start probe inherits that k and must still pass finite singular-value, retained-value cutoff, dimension, projected-rank, condition and subspace gates, but it does not redetect k from the temporary start gap. Every order-final probe continues to require a fresh smallest qualifying gap agreeing with the frozen k, in addition to the final null-decay, residual-decay, projected-order and error gates.

synthetic_findings.finding: The pre-execution unit-test ledger expected four total iterations. A perturbed confirmation first reaches the quadratic root and then requires a second complete step to demonstrate the frozen normalized-last-step stop condition, so two primary plus two two-step confirmations consume six iterations.
synthetic_findings.correction: Correct only the synthetic test expectations. For the nullity-one fixture the candidate consumes 516 callbacks and 126 factorizations; the independent analytic control consumes 124 callbacks, 70 factorizations and 42 charged analytic-Jacobian calls. The observed increments exactly equal the two required confirmation steps.

synthetic_findings.finding: Julia 1.12.6 rejects trailing commas after unparenthesized generator expressions in three work-ledger reductions.
synthetic_findings.correction: Remove only those trailing commas; the reductions, persisted fields and gate operands are unchanged.
